derived_last_point.note: A2 := target - A1 is computed, not searched; same language (bijection), so counts are unchanged and free input bits halve (4d -> 2d). Steps are Meter diagnostics.

eccp131.derivation: Functional backend visits 2^(free input bits); measured equal to 2^(4d) at d=3,4; two slots at d=131 give 4*131 = 524 free bits

notes: steps are hashed-ecdl-tensor Meter charges: deterministic diagnostics, not calibrated time units

recursion_crossover.note: transcribed from recursive.rs Setup::parameters; recursion engages only above ~2^131070 edges, so no feasible curve reaches it and every count here used the exact fallback

is_prime.consequence: Curve::new and FactorBase::new certify the prime, so no curve with a prime above 64 bits (ECCp-131's is 131-bit) can even be set up; this blocks before the contraction cost matters
is_prime.dispatch: is_prime uses a fast u64 path at <= 64 bits and AKS above (arithmetic.rs); AKS is impractical, so a prime above 64 bits cannot be certified in reasonable time

multiply_construction.verdict: fast at every width (linear); not a bottleneck

upstream_pruning.note: crate change landed upstream (Counter::functional_pruning); measured here, not authored here
